capture_policy.provenance_scope: Exact public-page fields were transcribed from the linked OCC Corporate Applications Search records and official SBIC company pages. No claim is made that raw HTTP bytes, response headers or signed regulator receipts were retained.
capture_policy.source_independence: The three charter records are separate filings from the same OCC CAS system and are not independent publishers. SBIC regional company profiles are separate primary company sources.

occ_cas.status_definition: The OCC Corporate Applications Search page explicitly lists the filing status action Consummated/Effective and its date. This is a regulator-recorded charter status, not proof of customer asset balances, XRP use, lending volume or commencement of every proposed product.

records.parent_company: Coinbase Global, Inc. (identified in OCC Corporate Decision #1370)
records.transaction_form: Charter National Bank Under Holding Company (Trust Bank)

scope_from_corporate_decision_1370.custody_customer_transactional_services: Accept, hold and transfer custodied fiat currency and digital assets within the customer's custodial account.
scope_from_corporate_decision_1370.affiliate_access: Finder access only to Coinbase affiliates' staking, prime trading and prime financing; the trust bank does not itself provide those underlying services.
scope_from_corporate_decision_1370.cash_custody: Fiat held in custody is placed in for-benefit-of accounts at third-party banks.

capital_conditions.eligible_liquid_assets_requirement: Greater of at least 50% of Tier 1 capital or USD 30 million.
capital_conditions.operating_expense_liquidity: 180 days of operating expenses in Eligible Liquid Assets, not double-counted with the preceding requirement.
capital_conditions.duration: First three years of operation, subject to the decision's conditions.

evidence_limitations: The CAS effective date is not an AUC balance or proof that a particular asset such as XRP is held.
The OCC decision describes a trust-company business, not a commercial deposit-taking bank.
The capital requirements are regulatory conditions, not evidence that USD 60 million was actually raised or that XRP was purchased.
Affiliate prime-financing access is a finder/referral relationship, not proof that the trust bank itself lends.

records.parent_company: Ripple (company-reported relationship; OCC CAS record identifies the proposed bank name and filing status)
records.transaction_form: Charter National Bank Under Holding Company (Trust Bank)
records.scope_company_reported: Segregated RLUSD reserve management, collateral-trustee functions for RLUSD holders and fiduciary digital-asset custody.
evidence_limitations: The company-described RLUSD reserve and collateral-trust functions do not establish XRP collateralization.
RLUSD issuer identity remains distinct from the national trust bank.
No XRP acquisition, XRP balance, collateral utilization or customer-flow amount is established by the CAS status record.

records.entity: First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A.
records.transaction_form: Charter National Bank Under Holding Company (Trust Bank)
records.scope_company_reported: Fiduciary custody; Circle described reserve-management capability as a future capability in its announcement.
evidence_limitations: The trust bank is not thereby established as the USDC issuer; Circle's regulated issuer affiliates remain distinct.
A reserve-management capability announcement is not proof of XRP reserve allocation or XRP collateral use.
No XRP acquisition, XRP balance or XRP payment flow is established by the CAS status record.

interpretation: All three separate national trust-bank filings now show OCC CAS status Consummated/Effective: Circle 2026-07-24, Ripple 2026-10-26 and Coinbase 2026-11-06.
The Coinbase status is no longer OCC-DOCUMENT-PENDING. The official CAS detail page resolves the earlier discrepancy with the slower-updating Interpretations & Decisions index.

The Interpretations & Decisions index lists published decisions through September 2026 and is updated as letters are ready for publication; its lack of a later row does not override the individual CAS filing status.
The three charters are institutional custody/trust infrastructure. Their effective dates do not establish that XRP is required, held, pledged, purchased or used as a settlement asset.

actual_capital_taxonomy.regulatory_capital_requirement: A legal minimum or liquidity condition imposed on a regulated entity.
actual_capital_taxonomy.paid_in_or_raised_capital: Cash/equity actually contributed or raised; not established by the OCC CAS status pages.
actual_capital_taxonomy.assets_under_custody: Client assets held in custody; not the custodian's own capital and not automatically market purchases.
actual_capital_taxonomy.stablecoin_reserves: Assets backing a stablecoin issuer's liabilities; not XRP collateral unless the issuer explicitly discloses XRP in the reserve composition.
actual_capital_taxonomy.xrp_spot_acquisition: Executed XRP purchases net of sales and transfers; requires trade/settlement or equivalent primary evidence.
actual_capital_taxonomy.xrp_collateral_utilization: XRP actually pledged and outstanding in a lending/financing position; custody or collateral eligibility alone is insufficient.
